name: whatsapp_people
description: Lists the contacts the user assigned to this assistant with the fields of their record: what you noted in notes/people/<number>.md, such as sale_status or company. Use it when the user asks who is in some state (for example, who got a quote), what is known about their contacts, or looks for someone by a detail. It reads no messages (that is whatsapp_chats) and does not search the phone's address book (that is whatsapp_contacts). Returns one line per person: +number | name | role | field=value; field=value.

where.description: field=value to filter on, as written in the records (e.g. sale_status=quoted). Leave it out to list everyone.

search.description: A word that must appear in the name, the record or the notes (e.g. "logo"). Optional.
